selection: Fixed before reading the three campaign outcomes

slow_event.eligibility: Every case must have observed coverage of the entire fixed window; otherwise skip and record the reason

ended_case_policy: Hold only the final saved pose, show ENDED / NO LATER OBSERVATION and exact coverage on its panel; stop its scientific trace at the final observation

measurement_labels.absolute_tilt_deg: Angle between the actual platform up axis and world up
measurement_labels.raw_target_error_deg: Angle between actual and unchanged raw-target platform up axes; yaw is excluded
measurement_labels.world_wz_rad_s: Actual free-body angular velocity rotated from its local qvel angular coordinates into world Z

rendering_boundary: Saved native Gazebo states; display-only MuJoCo scene; mj_kinematics/comPos/camlight only, with no controller, observer, contact solve or physics integration
inference_boundary: Video is descriptive evidence, not the acceptance-gate analysis. A completed run and an accepted candidate are separate outcomes.
